title: Rooftop-aware optimization of electric bus depot charging, photovoltaic generation, and battery storage under grid-capacity constraints
description: Reproducibility package for the Energy manuscript on rooftop-aware optimization of electric bus depot charging, photovoltaic generation, and battery storage under grid-capacity constraints in Bogota. The archive contains source code, processing scripts, scenario definitions, lightweight processed input data, and reference CSV result files needed to reproduce and verify the computational experiment. Manuscript files, editorial figures, third-party raw data, large geospatial archives, and downloaded third-party PDFs are not redistributed.
